scenes.conflict: Venn dismisses the warning as stress and wants the vats kept on schedule, while Nadia's closest friends keep humming in unison and abandon their posts.
scenes.goal: Nadia wants to convince Venn that the shared humming among brood workers is a sign of infection and not a malfunction.
scenes.outcome: Venn reluctantly agrees to check the Trench Pen, and Nadia is told to keep quiet about the humming. This leaves both women with a secret they cannot share.
scenes.summary: Nadia reports the unison humming after the First Chorus. Venn's possessive interest in Mother Tithe pushes her to investigate while downplaying the danger to workers.
scenes.title: The First Hum

scenes.conflict: The pen is dangerous, and Wen's submersible is controlled by the Containment Office, so Venn can only reach the pen on Wen's terms and under pressure from the watching Chorus.
scenes.goal: Venn wants to confirm that Mother Tithe is communicating and to bring back evidence of her sentience.
scenes.outcome: Venn records Mother Tithe's bioluminescent pulses answering the workers' humming, proving the sentience is real and spreading. Wen sees it too and cannot go back to neutrality.
scenes.summary: Wen carries Venn to the Trench Pen, where Mother Tithe's pulses synchronize with the humming workers.
scenes.title: Light in the Trench

scenes.conflict: Venn demands the creature be kept alive, Brandt demands a seal and destruction, and Oyelaran demands uninterrupted output. All of them are threatened by funding cuts under the shareholder clock.
scenes.goal: Each department head wants to claim the crisis for their own shareholder bloc at the scheduled uplink report.
scenes.outcome: The heads fail to agree. Brandt orders the Lifeboat Ring sealed and Oyelaran promises his shareholders production will continue, which locks the three factions into open rivalry.
scenes.summary: The three heads meet at the Spindle, and their competing mandates make a united response impossible.
scenes.title: Quarterly Clock

scenes.conflict: The lifeboats cover about half the crew, and Oyelaran invokes executive rank while Brandt invokes her ledger of names. Wen is caught in between holding the submersible's berths.
scenes.goal: Brandt wants to enforce need-based evacuation, while Oyelaran wants the berths allocated by corporate rank.
scenes.outcome: Brandt holds the Ring sealed, and Oyelaran threatens to have her replaced. Wen declines to give up the submersible berth list.
scenes.summary: The Lifeboat Lockdown becomes a standoff over who may leave, and it establishes the evacuation conflict.
scenes.title: The Ring Seals

scenes.conflict: Oyelaran orders full output to protect the dividend. Reyes hides infected workers on the line and cannot refuse the order without losing his job.
scenes.goal: Reyes wants to keep Oyelaran's inspectors away from his crew, some of whom are showing signs of infection.
scenes.outcome: Reyes keeps the secret, but the infected workers contaminate the ampoule lines, and the symbiont starts to enter the shared water supply.
scenes.summary: Reyes covers for his infected crew while Oyelaran pushes production, and the contagion reaches the Refinery.
scenes.title: Hidden Hands

scenes.conflict: Her friends have lost individual will and turn on her, while Venn treats the infected as research subjects.
scenes.goal: Nadia wants to pull her infected friends away from the Chorus using her Early Warning skill, and Venn wants access to the vats.
scenes.outcome: Nadia saves one technician for a short time but loses the rest, and she realizes that Venn has been using her to reach the Chorus. Her trust in Venn breaks.
scenes.summary: Nadia's attempt to reach her friends fails and exposes the cost of Venn's possessiveness.
scenes.title: Absorbed

scenes.conflict: Each is guarding secrets about infected crew, and each fears that the other will report them to Brandt or Oyelaran.
scenes.goal: Nadia and Reyes want to find out how the symbiont moves between the Cisterns and the Refinery before the water supply is lost.
scenes.outcome: They trade what they know and agree to work together outside their departments, which puts them at odds with their heads.
scenes.summary: Nadia and Reyes bond over the colleagues they are trying to save and map the spread of the symbiont.
scenes.title: Shared Water

scenes.conflict: Wen sees that the plan abandons infected crew Brandt could still save, and Brandt treats them as already lost.
scenes.goal: Brandt wants Wen to commit the submersible to the evacuation plan and seal the infected sections.
scenes.outcome: Wen refuses to commit the submersible until she knows the plan's cost. Brandt begins to doubt her own rules.
scenes.summary: Brandt's rigid plan runs into Wen's reluctance, and the ledger of names starts to haunt her.
scenes.title: The Ledger

scenes.conflict: Reyes reveals that the infected are on his lines and Venn demands the creature, so both threaten Oyelaran's standing while he privately knows production cannot continue.
scenes.goal: Oyelaran wants to use Venn's access to Mother Tithe and Reyes's crew to keep production running as his shareholders threaten to replace him.
scenes.outcome: Oyelaran redirects oxygen and supply budgets to the Refinery and the Spindle, which accelerates the shortage in the other sections and forces Reyes and Venn to act.
scenes.summary: Oyelaran's pressure and budget control escalate the crisis and drive the others to rebel.
scenes.title: Funding Cut

scenes.conflict: The Chorus guards the pen and speaks in unison, and the water is infected. Nadia feels the pull to join and Venn's possessiveness blocks any attempt to harm the creature.
scenes.goal: Venn wants to open a controlled channel with Mother Tithe, and Nadia and Wen want to find a way to break the Chorus's hold.
scenes.outcome: Mother Tithe answers through the Chorus and shows that infected workers retain traces of individual will. Venn must confront the possibility that her enhancements caused the contagion.
scenes.summary: Venn, Nadia and Wen reach the Trench Pen and make first contact with the Chorus.
scenes.title: Descent to Mother Tithe

scenes.conflict: Venn presents the evidence that the infected keep some will, and Brandt and Oyelaran both fear what it means for their mandates and their shareholders.
scenes.goal: Each head wants to impose a plan for Mother Tithe and the colony: capture, destroy or keep producing.
scenes.outcome: Oyelaran's override is exposed and Brandt breaks from her insurers' mandate, and Venn gives up the idea of keeping Mother Tithe at any price. They agree to a joint plan, but Oyelaran slips away to secure his own berth.
scenes.summary: The heads confront the central conflict and a fragile alliance forms.
scenes.title: Three Mandates

scenes.conflict: Brandt's seal order would trap infected crew, Oyelaran blocks the evacuation to protect the output, and the Chorus advances through the water.
scenes.goal: Reyes and Nadia want to bring the infected out of the Refinery before the symbiont reaches the ampoule lines, and Brandt wants to seal it.
scenes.outcome: Reyes tests whether an infected worker can act on their own will and succeeds. Brandt chooses to carry the infected out instead of sealing them in, and Oyelaran loses control of the Refinery.
scenes.summary: The compromise is tested in the Refinery as Brandt, Reyes and Nadia decide the fate of the infected.
scenes.title: The Refinery Stand

scenes.conflict: Containing the symbiont means interrupting the creature that Venn has built her life around, and doing it puts her own life at risk. The Chorus resists and Nadia is drawn toward it.
scenes.goal: Venn wants to negotiate a way to contain the contagion with Mother Tithe, and Nadia wants to reach the individuals inside the Chorus.
scenes.outcome: Venn risks her research and her life to open the channel, and Nadia anchors the infected workers' will. The Chorus releases most of the workers and Mother Tithe is left contained but alive.
scenes.summary: The climax resolves the central conflict in the Trench Pen as Venn gives up possession for negotiation.
scenes.title: The Last Channel

scenes.conflict: The oxygen reserves are low and only a few berths remain. He can keep his rank or hand over the budgets that would save others.
scenes.goal: Oyelaran wants to secure his lifeboat berth and shareholder position, and Brandt wants him to answer for the override.
scenes.outcome: Oyelaran gives the crew the remaining oxygen and supply reserves at the cost of his standing, and his last act shows what he is. Brandt records his name in her ledger.
scenes.summary: Oyelaran's arc ends with a choice that costs him his position.
scenes.title: Final Accounting

scenes.conflict: The berths still cover only about half the crew, and ascent requires a long decompression with no outside rescue. Brandt's insurers' mandate forbids carrying the infected to the surface.
scenes.goal: Brandt and Wen want to fill every berth by need, including the recovering infected, before the oxygen runs out.
scenes.outcome: Wen commits the submersible and takes responsibility for the result. Brandt breaks her mandate and loads infected and uninfected crew by need, and Reyes goes with his crew.
scenes.summary: Brandt and Wen run the evacuation by need and treat the infected as people.
scenes.title: By Need

scenes.conflict: Venn faces her guilt over the neural enhancements, and Nadia has to decide whether to trust the mentor who used her. Mother Tithe still hums in the dark.
scenes.goal: Venn wants to own what she created, and Nadia wants to make sure the surviving workers can keep their will.
scenes.outcome: Venn accepts responsibility and stays to monitor the contained creature, and Nadia stays as an equal partner. The colony survives, changed and watched by the shareholders above.
scenes.summary: The resolution shows the cost of the crisis and the new, uneasy bond between Venn and Nadia.
scenes.title: Those Who Stay

logline: When the colony's largest engineered leviathan turns Mariana Six's workers into a hive mind, three rival department heads must choose between saving the station and securing the creature for their shareholders, while oxygen runs out and the lifeboats can carry only half the crew.
theme: Profit and possession cost us the people we claim to protect.
title: Abyssal Shares
